title: Tech Note: Transform a Utility Form into One Executable Method
author: Add Komoncharoensiri, Director of Technical Services, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This is a niche but still-valid technique for anyone needing to package and share a self-contained utility dialog as a single file; nothing about project-mode forms, macros, or the Open form window/DIALOG commands referenced here has been deprecated. It remains a specialized trick rather than a mainstream workflow, and most teams today would more likely share reusable UI via a proper 4D component or shared project rather than a single consolidated method, but the underlying technique described still works as documented.
related_updates: Still technically valid; for larger-scale reuse, most teams today would prefer packaging shared UI as a proper 4D component rather than a single consolidated method.
